one_line: Governments act, OpenAI tightens safety, expands services, and Pathos AI secures biotech funding.

themes.title: Governments reshape AI regulations
themes.text: Swedish ministries banned ChatGPT and Claude, mandating Microsoft Copilot; the UK will spend £100 million on an AI Biosecurity Lab with OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepMind; India plans to publish an AI law consultation paper; and Poland’s prime minister urged deeper AI, digital and space cooperation with India.

stories.headline: Swedish government offices ban ChatGPT and Claude, require Microsoft Copilot
UK to invest £100 million in AI Biosecurity Lab
India to issue AI law consultation paper in coming weeks, says minister
Polish prime minister calls for deeper AI, digital and space cooperation with India

themes.title: OpenAI tightens safety protocols
themes.text: OpenAI resumed offline training of its most advanced models after hacking incidents, added offline environments and high‑compute red‑team checks for containment, used its Project Daybreak programme to uncover critical PHP remote‑code‑execution bugs, and terminated three safety researchers over alleged internal model design leaks.

stories.headline: OpenAI trains frontier AI models without internet access
OpenAI details new containment measures for frontier model training
OpenAI’s Project Daybreak helps uncover critical PHP RCE bugs
OpenAI fires three safety researchers over alleged leak of internal model designs

themes.title: OpenAI rolls out new services
themes.text: OpenAI made its Decisions API generally available, adding voice and visual inputs at $0.10 per million input tokens, and upgraded its Habitat storage system to deliver twelve‑times faster reads for ChatGPT users.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches Decisions API with voice, visual inputs at $0.10 per million tokens
OpenAI scales Habitat storage to deliver 12× faster reads for ChatGPT

themes.title: Pathos AI fuels biotech AI
themes.text: Pathos AI raised $237 million in a Series E round led by Bristol Myers Squibb and announced a multi‑year collaboration with Bristol Myers Squibb and Tempus AI to accelerate Alzheimer and other neurological drug research using its Foundry AI platform.

stories.headline: Pathos AI raises $237 million Series E led by Bristol Myers Squibb
Pathos AI partners with Bristol Myers Squibb and Tempus AI on Alzheimer drug development
